sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT ?paper ?paperLabel ?biomarker ?biomarkerLabel WHERE {
  # papers that instantiate this template
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  # restrict to the template contribution class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C123091 .
  # biomarkers measured in the study
  ?contribution orkgp:P192000 ?biomarker .
  # human-readable biomarker value
  OPTIONAL { ?biomarker rdfs:label ?biomarkerLabel }
  # human-readable paper title
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel ?biomarkerLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?mmName ?mmNameLabel WHERE {
  # start from the paper and its top-level contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # the top-level contribution points to the process step instance
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P7108 ?hop1 .
  # any of the relations that reach a process-step instance
  VALUES ?link2 { orkgp:P43070 orkgp:P44026 orkgp:P44027 }
  ?hop1 ?link2 ?contribution .
  # restrict to the Tailored Forming Process Step contribution class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C21032 .
  # the measurement method reported for the step
  ?contribution orkgp:P44012 ?mm .
  # name of the measurement method (geometry, hardness profile, ...)
  ?mm orkgp:P7111 ?mmName .
  # human-readable label of the measurement method name
  OPTIONAL { ?mmName rdfs:label ?mmNameLabel }
  # human-readable paper title
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel ?mmNameLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?matrix ?matrixLabel WHERE {
  # start from the paper and its top-level contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # the top-level contribution links to the nested variable instance
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P135056 ?hop1 .
  # relations that reach the Variable instance
  VALUES ?link2 { orkgp:P27012 orkgp:P27011 }
  ?hop1 ?link2 ?contribution .
  # restrict to the Variable contribution class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C67003 .
  # the matrix the variable was observed in
  ?contribution orkgp:P117006 ?matrix .
  # human-readable matrix label
  OPTIONAL { ?matrix rdfs:label ?matrixLabel }
  # human-readable paper title
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel ?matrixLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?algorithm ?algorithmLabel WHERE {
  # start from the paper and its top-level contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # the top-level contribution links to the nested machine learning instance
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P15124 ?hop1 .
  # the machine learning contribution instance
  ?hop1 orkgp:P57016 ?contribution .
  # restrict to the Machine Learning contribution class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C29012 .
  # the algorithm reported in the publication
  ?contribution orkgp:P2001 ?algorithm .
  # human-readable algorithm label
  OPTIONAL { ?algorithm rdfs:label ?algorithmLabel }
  # human-readable paper title
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel ?algorithmLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?value ?valueLabel WHERE {
  # start from the paper and its top-level contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # the top-level contribution links to the zeta potential instance
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P37298 ?contribution .
  # restrict to the Zeta Potential contribution class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C20047 .
  # the zeta potential value reported
  ?contribution orkgp:HAS_VALUE ?value .
  # human-readable value label
  OPTIONAL { ?value rdfs:label ?valueLabel }
  # human-readable paper title
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?unit ?unitLabel ?ucumCode WHERE {
  # start from the paper and its top-level contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # relations that reach a Quantity Value instance
  VALUES ?link1 { orkgp:P142035 orkgp:P175001 orkgp:P175002 }
  ?paperContribution ?link1 ?contribution .
  # restrict to the Quantity Value contribution class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C67005 .
  # the qudt:unit of the quantity value
  ?contribution orkgp:P118088 ?unit .
  # human-readable unit label
  OPTIONAL { ?unit rdfs:label ?unitLabel }
  # qudt ucum code of the unit when stated
  OPTIONAL { ?unit orkgp:P45081 ?ucumCode }
  # human-readable paper title
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel

  # start from the paper and its top-level contribution

  ?paperContribution orkgp:P37365 ?hop1 .

  ?hop1 orkgp:P71154 ?contribution .
  # restrict to the Evaluation item contribution class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C40018 .
  # the textual value of the evaluation item
  ?contribution orkgp:P71153 ?textValue .

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>

  # start from the paper and its top-level contribution

  # relations that reach a hypothesis instance
  VALUES ?link1 { orkgp:P30001 orkgp:P95001 orkgp:P29013 }
  ?paperContribution ?link1 ?contribution .
  # restrict to the invasion biology hypothesis contribution class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C65014 .
  # the research field the hypothesis is studied by
  ?contribution orkgp:wikidata:P2579 ?field .
  # human-readable research field label
  OPTIONAL { ?field rdfs:label ?fieldLabel }
  # human-readable paper title
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?positionMeasure ?positionMeasureLabel WHERE {
  # start from the paper and its top-level contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # the top-level contribution links to the descriptive statistics instance
  ?paperContribution orkgp:P15124 ?hop1 .
  # the descriptive statistics contribution instance
  ?hop1 orkgp:P56048 ?contribution .
  # restrict to the Descriptive Statistics contribution class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C20073 .

  # human-readable label of the position measures
  OPTIONAL { ?positionMeasure rdfs:label ?positionMeasureLabel }
  # human-readable paper title

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>

PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?venue ?venueLabel WHERE {
  # the paper resource described with the Paper template
  ?paper a orkgc:Paper .
  # the venue reported for the paper
  ?paper orkgp:HAS_VENUE ?venue .
  # human-readable paper title
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
  # human-readable venue label
  OPTIONAL { ?venue rdfs:label ?venueLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel

  # start from the paper and its top-level contribution

  ?paperContribution orkgp:P43078 ?contribution .
  # restrict to the Qualities contribution class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C21038 .
  # the measurement reported for the quality
  ?contribution orkgp:P41861 ?measurement .

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?rmse ?rmseLabel WHERE {
  # start from the paper and its top-level contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # the top-level contribution links through the method to the accuracy record
  ?paperContribution orkgp:METHOD ?hop1 .
  # the accuracy contribution instance
  ?hop1 orkgp:P42007 ?contribution .
  # restrict to the accuracy contribution class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C40028 .
  # the root mean square error (RMSE) reported
  ?contribution orkgp:P62075 ?rmse .
  # human-readable RMSE label when available
  OPTIONAL { ?rmse rdfs:label ?rmseLabel }
  # human-readable paper title
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
} ORDER BY ?paperLabel
